newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers June same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers June same-store sales up.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said same-store sales for the five weeks ended July 5 were up 1.8 percent to $86.9 million from $85.4 million a year ago.
The clothing retailer said total June sales were $95.2 million, down 11.2 percent from $107.2 million for the five weeks ended July 6.
The company operated an average of 1,721 stores during June 1997, a decline of 15.6 percent from the 2,039 stores open in June 1996.
For the first 22 weeks of fiscal 1997, Edison Brothers' same store sales fell 0.8 percent to $369.3 million from $372.2 million in 1996.
Total sales year-to-date were off 12.6 percent to $395.5 million from $452.3 million, the retailer said.
